subject: Special Education Oversight
overview: School committee candidate Lisa Kingsley and David Kingsley discussed the role of the school committee in special education governance. They emphasized using systemic data collection, such as parent surveys, to inform policy and improve the special education experience in Medford.

items.title: School Committee Role in Special Education
items.summary: Lisa Kingsley explained how her professional background in leading IEP meetings will inform her governance and oversight role on the school committee.

items.title: Data Collection and Systemic Improvement
items.summary: The speakers discussed using district-wide data collection, such as parent surveys, to guide special education policy and focus on student instructional needs over compliance.
